about_the_game:
COMRADE, TRY THE DEMO—THAT’S AN ORDER!

Welcome to the Propaganda vs. Zombies demo, where you get a first taste of the revolutionary bullet hell deck-building combat that will shape the full game!

🔻 Test the Combat System: Battle 10 waves of zombies using a mix of firepower and propaganda. Experiment with different attack patterns, dodging mechanics, and deck synergies.

🔻 Build Your First Revolutionary Deck: Assemble a selection of powerful cards to either eliminate the undead or convert them into loyal Comrades who will fight for the cause.

🔻 Experiment with Strategy: Try different playstyles—whether through raw firepower, propaganda-fueled conversions, or a mix of both. See which tactics work best before the full uprising begins!

🔻 Survive the Onslaught: Face escalating waves of enemies in a fast-paced roguelike loop. Adapt to ever-growing threats, test different card combos, and master the art of survival.

The revolution begins now—download the demo and take your first steps in defending Hibura!
